name: Synapse.org
description:
Discover and explore scientific datasets from collaborative research projects. Search Synapse for genomics, imaging, clinical data on cancer, neurodegenerative diseases, rare diseases, and more. Navigate project hierarchies and get detailed metadata and provenance to understand what datasets contain before you download.

When using an MCP server with Claude, please review Anthropic's data handling policies to understand how your data is processed:
• [Consumer accounts](https://privacy.claude.com/en/collections/10672565-data-handling-retention)
• [Commercial accounts](https://privacy.claude.com/en/collections/10672411-data-handling-retention)

You remain responsible for compliance with any data use restrictions and Synapse [Terms of Service](https://www.synapse.org/TrustCenter:TermsOfService)

_published_faq.name: How do I add Synapse.org to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Synapse.org to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.synapse.org/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Synapse.org MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Synapse.org provides these MCP tools: get_entity, get_entity_annotations, get_entity_provenance, get_entity_children, and search_synapse.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Synapse.org?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Synapse.org in life-sciences on the Manufact MCP catalog include AdisInsight, Boltz API, Helix GenoSphere, Inductive Bio, and LatchBio.
Synapse.org requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Synapse.org is developed by Sage Bionetworks. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
